surface: operational dashboard dialog inside the authenticated warehouse scanner

primary_decision.statement: Which expected packages are still unresolved for this account and workday?
primary_decision.primary_action: Inspect the missing package list and resolve the physical discrepancy.

items.label: Missing packages and unresolved list
items.purpose: Present the consequence, decisive package evidence, and action in one bounded zone.
items.consequence_of_omission: The operator cannot determine whether the daily handoff is complete.

placement.justification: The missing count and its rows are the reason the report exists.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Missing count, consequence, and unresolved rows precede secondary history at both viewports.

items.label: Workday, refresh, and export controls
items.purpose: Select the ledger, request a complete refresh, or download the displayed rows.
items.consequence_of_omission: The operator cannot switch days, recover stale data, or replace the spreadsheet export.

placement.justification: Controls must establish scope before the user reads totals.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Date, refresh, and export remain together and never precede the report title.

items.demotion_reason: Controls support the decision but are not the decision itself.

items.label: Observed, cancelled, expected, scanned, and adjustment context
items.purpose: Explain how the missing count was derived and whether the day is closed or adjusted.
items.consequence_of_omission: The operator cannot audit the arithmetic behind the exception count.

placement.justification: The arithmetic must remain next to the consequence without competing with it.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Metrics remain readable and do not push the unresolved list behind unrelated history.

items.demotion_reason: These values explain the missing count but do not themselves identify the packages to act on.

items.label: Source truth and close status
items.purpose: State that the current ledger is based on bol shipment observation and identify late adjustments.
items.consequence_of_omission: Users may mistake observed shipment registration for an exact print event or miss a late change.

placement.justification: Truth context must remain visible but should not displace operational exceptions.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Source limitations and late adjustments remain present without becoming diagnostic chrome.

items.demotion_reason: It qualifies the figures but is not a package-resolution action.

items.label: Close report
items.purpose: Return focus to the scanner without disturbing the scan queue.
items.consequence_of_omission: Keyboard and mobile users cannot reliably return to scanning.

placement.justification: Dialog dismissal must remain predictable and visible.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Closing restores focus to the Daily report opener and then the existing scan loop.

items.demotion_reason: It exits the report but does not resolve a package discrepancy.
